title: Diviner [Singleplayer Only]
description:
[h1]Diviner[/h1]
[quote][b]Singleplayer only:[/b] Diviner currently supports singleplayer only. Multiplayer use is unsupported and may cause unstable behavior, broken game states, bugs, or crashes.[/quote]

[b]A complete Slay the Spire 2 character mod about reading the future, bargaining with fate, and surviving the consequences.[/b]

The Diviner begins each run with a [b]Crystal Ball[/b] and a Destiny value from 0 to 5. Destiny changes how the character's cards behave and reshapes parts of the run.

[b]Core mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Destiny[/b] moves between bad and good omens. Its different levels alter unknown rooms, reward rarity, and the conditions under which special card effects become active.
[*][b]Divinate[/b] records real information about the future run, including bosses, relic queues, shops, events, and Ancient rewards. Open the Crystal Ball ledger to review these predictions.
[*][b]Foretell[/b] queues effects for the start of your next turn, rewarding careful sequencing and preparation.
[*]At Destiny 0, [b]Doomed[/b] begins a lethal countdown that must be escaped. At high Destiny, [b]Revelation[/b] unlocks powerful card effects.
[*][b]Fortune[/b] and [b]Misfortune[/b] cards turn favorable and unfavorable omens into immediate tactical resources and risks.
[/list]

Expect a full character card pool, custom relics and potions, Ancient cards and relic interactions, custom combat and character artwork, a dedicated Destiny ledger, and extensive card-search and relic-forecast tools. The mod includes English and Simplified Chinese localization through Steam's language-specific Workshop pages.

[b]Requirement:[/b] BaseLib 3.3.2 or newer. Subscribe to the required item listed by Steam Workshop.

[h2]AI-generated content disclosure[/h2]
All original visual assets made for Diviner were generated with AI-assisted image tools, then selected, cropped, cleaned, resized, background-processed, and integrated by the mod author. No claim is made that these images were hand-painted. Game code, mechanics, balance, localization integration, asset processing, and implementation were assembled and maintained for this mod.
changeNote:
[h2]Doom Spiral balance update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Doom Spiral now sets Destiny to 0 when played instead of lowering Destiny every turn.
[*]At the start of each turn, Doom Spiral adds a Misfortune to your hand; Doom Spiral+ adds Misfortune+.
[*]Updated English and Simplified Chinese card and power text.
[*]Preserved automatic Innate rendering so the keyword appears exactly once.
[/list]
